title: BUMP: Brief Unexpected Mid-Interpolation Peak
abstract: arXiv:2611.08182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We identify an intriguing phenomenon when linearly interpolating between permutation-aligned neural networks: test accuracy briefly improves near the interpolation endpoints before dropping toward the midpoint, which we term BUMP (Brief Unexpected Mid-interpolation Peak). We observe that BUMP appears consistently across datasets, architectures, training regimes, and remains robust under substantial perturbations such as early checkpoints and extreme pruning. Moreover, controlled ablations suggest that it cannot be attributed to trivial regularization effects. While similar near-endpoint gains are visible in prior interpolation plots, they have not been explicitly documented or systematically and thoroughly analyzed. Leveraging this effect, we propose a simple, novel ensembling scheme: weight-prediction mixed ensembling that combines weight mixing with prediction-space mixing. translated_title: BUMP：短暂意外的插值中段峰值
translated_abstract: 我们在两个置换对齐的神经网络之间进行线性插值时发现了一个有趣的现象：测试精度在插值端点附近会短暂提升，随后向中点方向下降，我们将这一现象称为 BUMP（Brief Unexpected Mid-interpolation Peak，短暂意外的插值中段峰值）。我们观察到，BUMP 在不同数据集、不同架构和不同训练方案下均一致出现，并且在早期检查点和极端剪枝等剧烈扰动下依然保持稳健。此外，受控消融实验表明，该现象无法归因于简单的正则化效应。尽管类似的近端点增益在以往的插值曲线图中有所显现，但此前并未被明确记录，也未得到系统性、深入的分析。利用这一效应，我们提出了一种简单而新颖的集成方案：权重-预测混合集成，它将权重空间的混合与预测空间的混合相结合。在我们的全部实验中，所得的集成方法始终取得一致的表现。
tldr: 本文发现了神经网络插值中的 BUMP 现象（测试精度在插值端点附近短暂提升后向中点下降），并基于此提出了将权重混合与预测空间混合相结合的新型集成方法。
en_tdlr: We discover BUMP, a phenomenon where test accuracy briefly peaks near the endpoints when linearly interpolating between permutation-aligned neural networks, and leverage it to propose a novel weight-prediction mixed ensembling scheme.
